notes.title: Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams new chapter available!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!
a new update for the Suicide Guy: The Lost Dreams is coming soon for the game, check it out on the official steam page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423470/Suicide_Guy_The_Lost_Dreams/

If you haven't yet, follow and add to your wishlist!

Next patch will be based on all your feedback and will include:

- 3 extra exclusive new levels!
- Performance improvements
- Achievements bug fixes
- Minor glitches fixes


Stay tuned!
Chubby Pixel

notes.title: Update 1.24 and Steam Cards!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!
The update 1.24 is now available for Suicide Guy VR!

It includes:

- Compatibility with all other VR devices (Cosmos, Vive)
- Many bug fixes
- Controls Improvements

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316760/Suicide_Guy_VR/

The update comes also with Steam cards + Community Items!
Have fun!

- Fixed the controls for the HTC Vive controls
- Added a new extra level (you can find in the main room level selection)
- Improved ledge climbing
- Crouch movement fixes
- Minor bugs fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38269209/3b47cfc6ff1fd8cab78e152e8792b00523105ebe.jpg
